basic_info.description: Welcome to 2080 3rd Street, nestled in the vibrant Dogpatch neighborhood  the sunniest side of San Francisco.  This boutique 10-unit elevator building features a spacious bi-level corner live/work loft with 1 bedroom, 1.5 bathrooms, a private deck, and 1-car parking.  The main level showcases an open-concept layout with a chef's kitchen complete with a gas range, stainless steel appliances, and a central island. Step outside to your expansive deeded patio  perfect for BBQs, entertaining, or simply relaxing outdoors.  Upstairs, the bright bedroom offers an updated full bathroom, walk-in closet, and its own private entry. Soaring windows flood the home with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout.  With low HOA dues of just $565/month (including water, garbage, exterior insurance, and professional management, google fiber wifi), this home makes city living both convenient and stress-free.    The location is unbeatable: steps from a newly opened waterfront park, close to Dogpatch dining and cafes, and within easy reach of Mission Bay, UCSF, Chase Center, and the city's growing life science hub. Excellent transit and commuting options include the T line, I-280, and CalTrain to the airport.
